description: Land Aquisition - Matuwagala, Kiriella D/S Division, Ratnapura District, Land Aquisition - Amendent. Ex. Ordinary Gazette No. 2104/32 Homagama Division Secretariat Sec 07
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific land parcel descriptions, extents, cadastral map references, and compensation procedures for public purposes. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
